headline: Rams officially place Myles Garrett on injured reserve
summary: The Rams have made one of their expected roster moves official on Thursday.

headline: Lions Down Multiple O-Line Starters
summary: Visiting Buffalo on Thursday night, Detroit will have to start multiple backups along the offensive line. The Lions have ruled out right tackle Blake Miller (knee) and left guard Christian Mahogany (hip) for Week 2. Beginning with the March release of longtime stalwart Taylor Decker, the Lions shook up their offensive tackle alignment in the offseason. […]

headline: Tyson Campbell did not practice Thursday with ankle injury
summary: Already thin at cornerback, the Browns are dealing with another injury at the position.

headline: Will Anderson calls Texans’ loss to Bills a 'wake-up call' for the defense ahead of Bengals visit
summary: — Houston Texans defensive end Will Anderson said giving up 36 points in a season-opening loss to the Bills wasn’t a reason to get mad but instead should be a catalyst to improve.

headline: Ben Johnson and Brian Flores face off again as the Bears take on the Vikings in Week 2
summary: — It's a stressful week for Chicago Bears coach Ben Johnson. Same for Minnesota Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores.

headline: The 49ers return from dominating win in Australia to take on the Dolphins in home opener
summary: — The scenario to start the season for the San Francisco 49ers couldn't have been much more challenging.
